services.title: Broadcast Service
services.description: Cutting-edge broadcast services combining state-of-the-art technology with personalised support for seamless transmission and maximum impact.

services.title: Equipment Hire
services.description: Professional cameras and lenses, lighting, audio gear and post-production tools to support every stage of your production workflow.

services.title: Crew Hire
services.description: Directors, cinematographers, producers, sound engineers and post-production specialists, on call across all four cities.

services.title: Bespoke Set Design
services.description: Our set designer team takes custom sets from the initial design concept through manufacturing and installation.

services.title: Direct-To-Link Feeds
services.description: Live feeds from SNG to internet streaming protocols including TVU, LiveU, RTMP and SRT, backed by generator and UPS power.

services.title: Podcast & Radio
services.description: Podcast mics, wireless neck microphones and in-ear monitors for podcasts, radio shows and audio interviews.

why.title: 25+ Years of Experience
why.description: A reputation built on the quality of our facilities and our customer service.

why.title: Four Capital Cities
why.description: London, Dublin, Paris and Istanbul — one consistent production standard.

why.title: State-of-the-Art Equipment
why.description: Sony, Grass Valley and BlackMagic broadcast cameras, DMX-512 lighting grids and LED video walls.

why.title: Full Gallery Control Rooms
why.description: Professionally designed control rooms with Auto-Q systems and digital audio mixers.

why.title: 24/7 Reliability
why.description: Generator and UPS backup power with a 99.9% uptime guarantee.
